title: Architecture: semantic and execution boundaries
summary: ooRexx owns orchestration, intention and presentation semantics; media libraries and ML providers supply bounded evidence. Business objects remain the authority for customer data. Transport is selected outside each service.
invariants: Intention recognition does not authorize showing a customer's invoice, TPS report or account.
Media analysis never creates or changes business-service truth.
Connect Selector may choose direct invocation, JSON-RPC or Queue Fabric; Queue Fabric is preferred for retained jobs but is not mandatory.
Foreign Runtime v0.22.6 is the established native/Python boundary; Python Macrospace is optional and must not be substituted blindly.
Native mediaprocessing should remain renderer-neutral; do not force ooDialog or other toolkit object hierarchies into the semantic API.
procedure: Compose business intention, authorization, object retrieval, speech plan and scene plan separately.
Use Foreign Runtime to request the native/MediaPipe implementation when capability is present.
Return evidence references and media timings; do not transport raw 500 GB video through RPC messages.

provenance.claim: Independent timestamped transcription gateway and local face-analysis seam.
FFmpeg PTS range tracking and checkpoint interface, with MediaPipe not runtime-qualified.
